clips.hook: Her toes were partially digested — turned into basically one mega toe.

clips.title: Do Sharks Lay Eggs Or Give Birth?
clips.hook: They get birthed out of eggs. No dude, they get birthed out of shark ginies.
clips.description: Joe and Frank debate whether sharks lay eggs or give birth... and invent the word 'shark ginies'.
clips.social_caption: SHARK GINIES 💀 Joe thought sharks laid eggs 😭 #thebasementyard #comedy #shorts
clips.ig_caption:
They invented the phrase 'shark ginies' and I will never recover 💀 Did YOU know sharks don't lay eggs? 👇
#thebasementyard #funny #podcast #shorts
clips.pinned_comment: Be honest... did you think sharks lay eggs? 🦈😂
